interpretation: Each V cell is losslessly encoded once per full-attention call and each BF16 probability once per online tile. The wide encoding covers all BF16 bit patterns with the original product interpretation; K16 accumulation, online softmax, carry rounding and reciprocal tables are unchanged. The same 1059328-byte CK DLL is measured with the option disabled and enabled. All preparation and allocation are included in actual callback TTFT. Three complete product cases pass with a measured 857.6262 ms q8192 improvement. This opt-in trial does not renew the complete archive/context/soak gate or meet retained TTFT/TPOT targets; the r4 archive remains the completely qualified functional candidate.
